description: Word player holding ten banks of spoken words, with the bank and the word chosen by knob or CV and a word spoken on each trigger

params.text: Picks the word within the chosen bank, from its first to its last
Attenuates the WORD CV, from nothing through to its full range
Picks the bank, through the ten: pronouns, verbs, descriptors, nouns, connectors, time, emotions, numbers, questions and a custom bank of your own files
Attenuates the BANK CV, from nothing through to its full range

inputs.text: A rising edge speaks the word chosen at that moment; nothing is spoken until a trigger arrives
Adds to the word choice after its attenuator, 0-10V across the words in the chosen bank
Adds to the bank choice after its attenuator, a volt per bank across the ten
Shifts the pitch of the spoken word, -5V to 5V for half an octave either way, read at the moment the trigger arrives

outputs.text: The left channel of the spoken word
The right channel of the spoken word

notes: the ten banks of words are shipped with the plugin, so a word is spoken as soon as a trigger arrives
menu: Pitch CV Range — Bipolar: -5V to +5V, or Unipolar: 0V to 10V, setting how the PITCH input is read
Select Directory Containing Word Files — replaces the vocabulary with the WAV and MP3 files in a folder of your own
Interpolation — Off, or Linear (Better Quality), choosing how the samples between two stored samples are worked out
Visit r1n.ai — opens that web page in a browser

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
